definitions.gloss: copying sutras by hand; a hand-copied sutra
definitions.explanation: Copying a Buddhist sutra character by character with a brush, as an act of devotion or meditation. Many temples offer it to visitors, most often with the short Heart Sutra; the word also names the copy itself.

examples.japanese: {写経|しゃきょう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{体験|たいけん}した→体験する：09858_taikensuru⟧。
⟦お{寺|てら}→お寺：23515_otera⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{般若心経|はんにゃしんぎょう}→般若心経：32777_hannyashingyou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{写経|しゃきょう}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: To copy out the Heart Sutra at a temple.

examples.japanese: {写経|しゃきょう}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{一字|いちじ}⟦ずつ→〜ずつ：03092_zutsu⟧⟦{丁寧|ていねい}→丁寧：00896_teinei⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{書|か}く→書く：00477_kaku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、⟦{心|こころ}→心：01321_kokoro⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{落|お}ち{着|つ}く→落ち着く：04670_ochitsuku⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{人気|にんき}→人気：01488_ninki⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: Sutra copying is popular because writing each character carefully calms the mind.

notes:
Once the way sutras were spread before printing, it is now chiefly a practice: the copier traces or copies a model in ink, often writes a wish at the end, and dedicates the sheet to the temple (⟦{奉納|ほうのう}→奉納：12200_hounou⟧).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {写経|しゃきょう}⟦{体験|たいけん}→体験：11443_taiken⟧: a sutra-copying session for visitors
- {写経|しゃきょう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{奉納|ほうのう}→奉納：12200_hounou⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to dedicate a copied sutra to a temple
- ⟦{般若心経|はんにゃしんぎょう}→般若心経：32777_hannyashingyou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{写経|しゃきょう}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to copy the Heart Sutra

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {写仏|しゃぶつ}: tracing images of the Buddha, the companion practice
- ⟦お{経|きょう}→お経：17854_okyou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{読|よ}む→読む：00426_yomu⟧: to chant a sutra
